home.howSubtitle: From a WhatsApp voice note to your doorstep.
home.step1Body: She sends a product photo and a voice note in her own language.
home.step2Body: Title, description, category and a fair starting price are generated.
home.step3Body: A trusted local coordinator reviews and approves the listing.
home.step4Body: Buyers discover, order, and the artisan is alerted on WhatsApp.
home.demoTitleAccent: to a live listing — in 60 seconds.
home.demoDesc: This is the actual conversation an artisan has with our bot. A photo, a voice note in any of 5 Indian languages, and the listing is drafted, priced, and ready for a Karigar Sakhi to publish — no app, no forms, no English required.
home.demoFeature1Body: English, हिंदी, ಕನ್ನಡ, தமிழ், മലയാളം. Voice notes auto-transcribed — no typing needed.
home.demoFeature2Body: Title, description, fair price, category, tags — all drafted from one photo and one voice note.
home.demoFeature3Body: Every listing is reviewed by a local Karigar Sakhi before it reaches the marketplace. No bot-generated junk goes live.
home.demoFooter: Recreated from a real artisan flow · Live bot runs on WhatsApp

impact.label: Our impact
impact.title: We're not asking artisans to become digital sellers.
impact.titleAccent: We're making digital selling adapt to them.
impact.desc: HastKala turns WhatsApp — a tool women artisans already use every day — into direct market access. No app downloads. No seller dashboards to learn.
impact.problemTitle: Thousands of women artisans across 15+ craft districts are excluded from larger markets.
impact.problemDesc: They possess valuable traditional skills, but lack digital storefronts, cataloguing support, direct buyer access, and fair pricing. Middlemen often control the route to market — reducing income and limiting growth.
impact.metric1B: vs. typical middleman pricing on similar crafts.
impact.metric2B: Every listing reviewed before going live.
impact.metric6B: Trusted local support at every step.
impact.howTitle: From a WhatsApp voice note to a live storefront.
impact.pillar1B: Artisans now sell across regions, not just at the local fair.
impact.pillar2B: Direct prices, fair share, transparent orders.
impact.pillar3B: WhatsApp in Kannada, Hindi, Tamil, Malayalam, English.
impact.pillar4B: Order history, product catalog, repeat buyers.
impact.ctaTitle: Every order creates direct market access.
impact.ctaDesc: Browse Handmade crafts and support a woman artisan today.
